description:
A Twitch channel's latest videos (past broadcasts, highlights or uploads, up to 50) with title, duration, view count, dates, thumbnail and game.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), display_name (string), type (string), total_count (integer, nullable), videos (array<object>), videos_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return. Example: 20

type.description: Video type: archive (past broadcasts), highlight, upload or all. Example: "archive"

username.description: Twitch login name or channel URL. Example: "shroud"

name: twitch_videos
title: Twitch videos
